data.title: 伽玛 · 地下指挥所的沙盘部署
data.description: 阴影庭园地下指挥所内，伽玛站在巨大的沙盘前调动棋子。暗影与阿尔法不在时，这里由她坐镇——每一步调动都精确如账目。
data.location: underground command chamber of shadow garden with a giant strategy sand table and wall maps
data.action: standing at a sand table moving marker pieces, focused sharp gaze, slime bodysuit with gold trim
data.lighting: 沙盘上方魔石吊灯的冷白光与地图墙的微光
data.promptProse: At the sand table of the underground headquarters, Gamma moves the pieces with cool precision, holding the Garden's reins alone tonight.
data.animaCaption: With Shadow and Alpha away, Gamma's hand over the sand table is the steadiest in the Garden.
